# 100.00 CAD of sales booked to the receivable in two splits, 60.00 and 40.00.
#
# An invoice's posting puts its total on the receivable as one split, which is
# the split its lot holds. This transaction has two there, so it cannot be
# taken as any invoice's posting.
#
# What this fixture produces: one CAD transaction, two receivable splits
# against one income split, neither receivable split in a lot.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_posting_the_book_holds_is_refused_where_it_cannot_be_the_records.py.
